items.title: Check the validity period of your documents in advance
items.core: It will be too late to find out just before departure.
body: Confirm visa and passport validity.
Keep the photo and copy of the ID.
Make sure the passport is valid for at least six months before the end of the trip. Some countries have stricter requirements and need to confirm in advance.
Check whether the blank visa pages are enough for stamping. If there are less than two pages, you need to go to the Exit-Entry Administration Bureau in advance to apply for a replacement.
Look at the validity period on the back of your ID card or Hong Kong and Macao pass. If it is expired or is about to expire, you need to go to the window to renew the visa as soon as possible.

Case: Xiao Li packed his luggage the day before departure. He took out his passport and found that there was only one month left before it expired. He hurried to the immigration hall to apply for an expedited renewal. As a result, he spent an extra 300 yuan to catch the flight and almost missed the flight.

items.title: Leave room for travel
items.core: Overscheduling can turn an unexpected event into a disaster.
body: Only schedule one or two main things every day.
Allow traffic buffer.
Arrange at most two to three core attractions every day to avoid excessive physical exertion and ensure sufficient time for in-depth visits.
After marking the destination on the map, use navigation software to estimate the distance and allow at least one hour between the two journeys.
Allow at least one hour of free time in your daily schedule to deal with queues, getting lost, or weather emergencies.

Case: Xiao Wang’s ten-day trip to Europe was fully booked every day. On the third day, he was stranded due to a train strike. All subsequent hotel reservations and tickets were invalid, and he could only sleep at the train station, resulting in a loss of more than 4,000 yuan.

items.title: Budget allowance
items.core: Overspending often comes from uncalculated parts.
body: List cash, card and emergency limits.
Keep your emergency fund separate.
After making various basic cost estimates, an additional 15% of the total budget will be added as emergency funds to deal with price fluctuations.
Check the pricing standards of the destination taxi software in advance, and clearly calculate the transportation cost from the airport to the hotel into the initial budget.
Prepare a small amount of cash change equivalent to 500 yuan at the destination, specifically for situations where tips need to be paid or cash only is accepted.

Case: When Xiao Zhang went to Japan, he only counted air tickets and accommodation, not city transportation and checked baggage allowance. As a result, he paid the overweight fee and bought transportation coupons at the airport. His budget was at the bottom, and he could only eat rice balls from convenience stores in the last two days.

items.title: Prepare basic medicines
items.core: It may not be convenient to buy medicines in a strange place.
body: Bring commonly used medicines and prescriptions.
Learn about local ways to purchase medicines.
Carry gastrointestinal medicines such as montmorillonite powder or berberine to relieve diarrhea symptoms caused by acclimatization or unclean diet.
Prepare antipyretic analgesics such as ibuprofen or acetaminophen to deal with muscle aches caused by colds, fevers or long journeys.
Put a few pieces of waterproof band-aids and individually packaged iodophor cotton swabs in your small bag to deal with foot grinds or minor scratches at any time.

Case: Xiao Chen went hiking in the mountains of western Yunnan without any gastrointestinal medicine. He had a bad stomachache on the way. The small town drug store closed early and there were no corresponding over-the-counter medicines. He had no choice but to carry it on and suffered from diarrhea throughout the whole journey. His original plan to climb to the summit was ruined.

items.title: Download offline data first
items.core: You can still use it when the network is unstable.
body: Save maps, addresses and tickets.
Prepare conversion plugs and charging equipment.
Download the offline map package of the destination city in the map software before departure to ensure that you can still check public transportation and walking navigation when there is no network.

Download the offline language pack of the destination language in advance in the translation application, and you can conduct basic communication through voice or text even when the Internet is disconnected.

Save the screenshots of your flight itinerary and hotel reservation confirmation letter to the local photo album of your phone to prevent them from being loaded when you need to show them at any time.

Case: Xiao Zhao went to Xinjiang for a self-driving trip. There was often no mobile phone signal along the way. He downloaded offline maps and road books in advance and relied on offline navigation to find the right fork in the no-man's land of the Gobi, saving three hours of detour time.

items.title: Save trip data offline
items.core: You can travel even when the network is unstable.
body: Save maps, addresses and orders.
Print key documents.
Export your favorite web version of the travel guide as a PDF file and save it locally on your mobile phone. You can still view the route plan at any time when the Internet is disconnected.
Use a memo to record the Chinese and English names and detailed addresses of hotels, attractions and restaurants so that they can be viewed directly by taxi drivers.
Copy the Chinese embassy phone number, local police phone number and the contact information of your travel companions on a small piece of paper and put it in the wallet.

Case: When Xiao Liu arrived in Iceland, the airport network failed. He saved the hotel order, pick-up person's phone number and itinerary offline on his mobile phone in advance, showed it directly to the pick-up driver, and successfully arrived at his residence.

items.title: Check the validity period of the document in advance
items.core: The approaching expiration will affect entry.
body: Confirm validity period and blank page.
Keep the ID photo.

Carefully check the expiration date on the title page of your passport to ensure that the time between the day of entry and the expiry date is greater than the time limit stipulated by the destination country.
Open the passport and check whether there are more than two consecutive blank pages. Many countries require enough space for customs entry stamps.
Confirm that the multiple-entry visa you hold has not expired, and that the remaining number of entries is sufficient to cover all arrangements for this trip.

Case: Lao Zhou flew to Bangkok with a passport that had two months left to expire, but was refused entry by the customs on the grounds that the validity period was less than half a year. He changed his visa on the spot and returned to his country, losing nearly 3,000 yuan in air tickets and accommodation fees.

items.title: Prepare the visa materials according to the list
items.core: Missing one item may cause delays.
body: Check against the official list.
保留复印件。
Visit the official website of the embassy to download the latest application form, print it out and fill it in truthfully with a black signature pen and sign at the designated location.
Go to a photo studio to take ID photos according to the size and background required by the embassy. Note that the photo shooting time should not exceed six months.
Go to the bank counter to print out the salary card statements for the past six months, and be sure to ask the teller to stamp them with the official seal for banking business.

Case: When Xiao Sun applied for a Schengen visa, he thought he had all the documents. When he arrived at the visa center, he discovered that the bank statement stamp was missing. He was returned on the spot and had to reschedule the visa application and wait for two weeks. He almost lost the money he paid for the B&B.

items.title: Check air ticket information item by item
items.core: 姓名拼写错误无法登机。
body: 核对姓名和证件号。
确认行李额度。
Compare the English name on the ticket with the passport information page to ensure that there are no errors in the spelling of the first and last name.
Pay attention to check the specific departure time of the flight, and confirm the accurate terminal names of the departure and landing airports.
Log in to the airline's official website to confirm the checked baggage allowance in your order to avoid paying high fees for overweight after arriving at the airport.

Case: Xiao Wu purchased an international air ticket online, but did not check the pinyin of his name and spelled "Zhang Wei" as "Zhang Wei". He was refused check-in at the airport and the change fee was higher than the ticket price. He could only refund the ticket and buy a new one at an extra cost of 1,200 yuan.

items.title: Accommodation location is more important than photos
items.core: Transportation and safety affect the experience.
body: 查看周边和夜间环境。
确认前台服务时间。
Enter the hotel address on the map software and measure whether the walking time from the nearest subway station exit is within ten minutes.
Use the street view map to check whether there are convenience stores, pharmacies and supermarkets within 500 meters of the hotel to ensure the convenience of daily life.
Focus on reading the descriptions of nighttime noise and neighborhood security in recent guest reviews, and avoid choosing red light districts or remote areas.

Case: Xiao Lin was attracted by the sea view photos of the B&B and booked it in Mid-Levels. As a result, he spent an hour taking a taxi into the city every day. He did not dare to go out at night without street lights. The so-called sea view was only glimpsed from the balcony for ten minutes.

items.title: Allow time for transportation connections
items.core: Tight transfers will cause chain delays.
body: 留出缓冲。
了解备用线路。
When arranging international flight transfers, at least two and a half hours should be reserved between the two flights to prevent the previous flight from being delayed and missed.
If it is a convenient transfer within a high-speed rail station, you need to confirm whether you need to leave the station and reserve at least thirty minutes in case the train is delayed.
Check the departure interval of the next bus or subway on your mobile phone in advance to avoid missing the last bus and being forced to take a taxi.

Case: Xiao Zheng bought a connecting ticket and only had 50 minutes to transfer. The first flight was delayed by 40 minutes. When he landed, he rushed to the boarding gate but was still refused. He was forced to stay at the airport for 8 hours, and his hotel that night was canceled.

items.title: Prepare clothes according to the weather
items.core: The weather at the destination is different from that at the departure place.
body: 查看历史同期数据。
准备轻便外层。
Check the weather forecast of your destination one week before departure, focusing on the temperature difference between day and night, and decide whether to wear long sleeves or short sleeves.
If the forecast shows continuous rainfall, you need to prepare a lightweight folding umbrella and waterproof shoes in advance to avoid obstruction to your trip.
Considering that the car and indoor air conditioners are cold, it is recommended to wear multiple layers of clothing and carry a light jacket with you for easy putting on and taking off.

Case: Xiao He flew from Guangzhou to Harbin, and he only wore thin down according to southern experience. As a result, the local temperature was minus 20 degrees, and he was shivering from the cold on Central Street. He had to spend 800 yuan to buy thick cotton clothes to survive.

items.title: Understand baggage restrictions
items.core: Overweight charges are often higher than expected.
body: 确认重量和尺寸。
液体按规定包装。

After purchasing the ticket, take a screenshot of the carrier's single piece weight, three-sided dimensions and number of pieces, and save it in the album for easy presentation at the counter during disputes.
Use a weight scale or luggage scale to re-weigh before departure, and leave a half kilogram margin according to the displayed value to avoid fluctuations in re-weighing at the airport.
Check the carry-on and carry-on bag allowances separately on low-cost airlines. If the two are reasonable, don’t stuff heavy items into your coat pockets.

Case: When Xiao Li checked in at the airport, the luggage scale showed 24 kilograms, which exceeded the airline's 20 kilogram limit. He had to pay an overweight fee of 300 yuan on the spot, which also delayed the check-in baggage time.

items.title: Bring commonly used medicines and prescriptions
items.core: It may not be convenient to buy medicines in other places.
body: Keep original packaging.
Learn how to buy medicine locally.

Prepare an extra three to five days’ worth of medicines according to the number of days of your trip. Don’t wait until the last day for chronic disease medicines to prevent delays in returning and supply interruptions.

Keep the original packaging and instructions for tablets. For prescription drugs, bring a doctor’s prescription or diagnosis certificate, and be able to explain the purpose when you go through customs.
Check in advance the destination’s ban on ingredients containing ephedrine, codeine, etc. If you are unsure, consult your doctor before adjusting your medication.

Case: Ms. Wang went on a business trip to a remote county town and suffered a stomachache at night. The nearby pharmacy did not have her usual prescription medicine. She took the medicine first with the medicine box and copy of the prescription she brought with her, and then went to a regular hospital for a follow-up consultation the next day.

items.title: Prepare two payment methods
items.core: If a single channel fails, it will be very passive.
body: Credit cards and cash separately.
Inform the bank of your travel plans.
Bind the main card, backup card and mobile payment to different accounts to avoid risk control at one point or insufficient balance to stop them all.
Before departure, set up bank card out-of-town or overseas transaction reminders, and write down the customer service phone number of the card-issuing bank so that you can contact it if it is frozen.
Prepare small amounts of local cash to cover taxi rides, tips and consumption at stalls. Don’t just bring large denomination banknotes that are hard to find change.

Case: When Mr. Zhang was shopping in a foreign store, mobile payment failed due to risk control. He switched to a backup physical credit card to complete the payment, avoiding being left without money for meals and fares.

items.title: Prepare network connection in advance
items.core: Need navigation and contact after landing.
body: Learn about eSIM or local cards.
Download offline maps.
Before departure, confirm that the mobile phone supports the local network standard, and compare the traffic and validity period of the roaming package and local data card.
Save your hotel address, the route from the airport to your residence, and frequently used places offline. You can still find directions by taking screenshots when there is no internet connection.
Prepare a dual-port power bank and the corresponding conversion plug to keep your mobile phone and earphones charged during long-distance transfers.

Case: After Xiao Chen landed late at night, there was no free and stable network near the airport taxi station. The local traffic card he bought in advance was immediately available, and he successfully navigated to the hotel and reported to his family that he was safe.

items.title: Inform your family about your trip
items.core: It is safer to have someone know where you are.
body: Leave accommodation and flight information.
Agree on a safe time.
Send flight or train number, accommodation address, front desk phone number and names of traveling companions to a fixed contact person.
Agree on a safe period every day, and take the initiative to add a message when returning home late or changing routes to avoid misjudgment of the situation.
After arriving at your accommodation, send your location to the hotel entrance or the last two digits of your room number. Do not disclose the specific location in real time on social platforms.

Case: Xiaolin went hiking alone in the mountains. Before setting off, he sent his route, accommodation phone number, and estimated return time to his sister. His phone ran out of battery and lost contact during the journey. His sister contacted the scenic spot as planned and quickly confirmed that he came down safely.

items.title: Insurance policies are saved on your mobile phone
items.core: You need to recall them quickly when making claims.
body: 保存电子版。
Learn about coverage and calls.
Download electronic policies, electronic cards and insurance enrollment success emails to mobile phone folders, which can be opened even when the Internet is disconnected.
Write down the policy number, reporting phone number and all-day rescue number separately, and put them at the top of the memo for quick search.
Cut out pictures of the coverage, deductibles, and types of bills that need to be saved, and prepare the materials accordingly when you go to the doctor or report a case.

Case: A tourist needed emergency treatment after a fall at a ski resort. The front desk asked for the policy number and insurance information. He quickly found a screenshot of the policy in the photo album of his mobile phone, and successfully settled part of the claim after completing the registration.

items.title: Properties are stored dispersedly
items.core: One loss will not cause the whole army to be wiped out.
body: Separate cash and cards.
Keep valuables with you.
Divide cash into three small amounts and put them in your wallet, inner coat pocket and luggage compartment. Only take one of them every day.
Do not put two bank cards in the same folder. Keep the main card close to your body, and leave the backup card in the hotel safe or hidden luggage area.

Only put tissues and umbrellas on the outside of the backpack, put the mobile phone wallet in the close-fitting compartment, with the zipper facing inward and carry it in front of you as much as possible.

Case: Mr. Chen’s backpack was cut open at a night market, and the small amount of cash and bus card on the outer layer were stolen. However, the bank card and ID were placed in the inner bag, and he was still able to pay, take the bus, and return as originally planned.

items.title: Original documents should be kept intact as much as possible
items.core: Copies are usually sufficient for inspection.
body: The original is locked in a safe place.
Carry copies separately.
Scan the ID card, passport and visa pages into encrypted files, and send another copy to a trusted contact for backup.
Carry clear copies with you every day, and only take the originals when checking in, exchanging currency, or when requested by the official window.
Write down the ID number and the issuing authority so that you can fill in the information accurately when re-issuing or reporting a loss.

Case: When renting an electric car, the owner asked to register an ID card. Xiao Zhou only provided a copy of the ID card printed in advance and stated the purpose. After confirmation, the other party agreed to rent the car, and the original copy was always kept in the bag.

items.title: Be wary of over-enthusiastic strangers
items.core: Guidance and payment are often a prelude to asking for bribes.
body: Unsolicited baggage transfer is not accepted.
Insist on confirming the price yourself.
When you encounter someone who offers to lead the way or help carry your luggage, say no first and open the map to confirm the direction yourself.
Don’t accept drinks, cigarettes or quick photos from strangers. Watch your cup and cell phone before leaving.
If the other party temporarily increases the price or requires payment on your behalf, do not argue about payment, go directly to the ticket office or hotel front desk for verification.

Case: At the station exit, a man took the initiative to help a tourist carry her suitcase and said he could take her to the express lane, and then asked for tolls. The tourist refused to talk and went back to the station to follow the signs to avoid being cheated.

items.title: Check the vehicle information when taking a taxi
items.core: Confirm the license plate and driver before getting in the car.
body: Priority is given to using formal platforms.
Share your itinerary with your fellow travelers.
Before getting on the bus, compare the car model, color and last digits of the license plate displayed on the platform. If they are inconsistent, cancel and request a new taxi.
Confirm that the driver’s name is consistent with the order information. You can send the license plate and estimated arrival time to your family first at night.
Try to sit in the back row and enable itinerary sharing. If the route is obviously detoured, ask first and get off at a safe place if necessary.

Case: After requesting a taxi at night, a private car stopped on the roadside in advance and claimed to be the driver of the platform. Ms. Liu first checked the last two digits of the license plate and the driver's name. After finding that they were inconsistent with the order, she canceled the order and requested a new taxi.

items.title: Read reviews before booking accommodation
items.core: Location and safety are more important than photos.
body: Read recent negative reviews.
Confirm check-in time and front desk.
First read the negative reviews in the past three months, focusing on noise, sanitation, door locks and surrounding nighttime environment. Don’t just look at the refined pictures.
Check the walking distance to the station, convenience store and main road on the map, and choose routes with many turns into alleys carefully.
Confirm whether there is access control, a full-day front desk and an independent bathroom before booking a room, and give priority to room types with free cancellation.

Case: Before booking a B&B, Xiao Zhao noticed that the photos were beautiful but the negative reviews mentioned chaotic access control at night and long transportation distance. He changed his booking to a hotel with stable ratings next to the station. He checked in quickly after arriving late and was not in a hurry to catch the train the next day.

items.title: Carry valuables with you
items.core: It’s troublesome to deal with lost items when checking in.
body: 证件和电子设备随身。
Mark your luggage.
Do not put cameras, watches, jewelry and documents in checked baggage. Keep them in a personal bag within sight after boarding the plane.
In a restaurant or waiting area, wrap the bag strap around the leg of a chair and sit on the strap, then pick it up immediately when you stand up.
When wading in water, sweating, or changing clothes, make sure to transfer valuables to your carry-on bag first, and do not leave them on the table or in the laundry bag.

Case: Mr. Wu arrived half a day late after a business trip with his checked suitcase, which contained samples from his colleagues and his own camera. Because the camera and computer were carried on his back, he was still able to complete the day's demonstration and only tracked ordinary luggage.

items.title: Original documents are rarely required
items.core: Photocopies are usually sufficient.
body: The original is locked in a safe place.
Carry copies separately.
Before handling business, ask if you can use a copy or electronic copy. If you really need to verify the original, present it at the nearest location and take it back immediately.
Add the purpose, date and the words "re-copying is invalid" to the copy to prevent it from being used for other business.
Take photos to save ID information, but put the photos in encrypted albums. Do not send them to groups or to unknown businesses.

Case: When checking in at the hotel, the front desk said that he only needed to register his identity information. Xiao Li handed over a copy of his ID card and wrote "for check-in only" on it. The original was placed in a personal bag and the ID was intact when checking out.

items.title: Don’t show off your wealth or reveal your wealth
items.core: Displaying valuables in public can lead to risks.
body: Use equipment in a discreet manner.
不明场所不展示现金。
Only take with you the cash and cards you need for the day when you go out. Try to keep valuable jewelry at home or hide it close to your body.
Posting photos to Moments is delayed and does not display hotel door numbers, ticket barcodes, brand packaging and positioning.
When paying, avoid crowds and show your wallet and mobile phone balance. If you find someone watching closely, move to the store clerk to operate.

Case: When visiting the night market on the weekend, Xiao Wang covered the cuffs of the newly purchased watch. He did not take out a large amount of cash when paying, but only used his mobile phone to scan the QR code. The people watching nearby saw that there was no profit and quickly left.

items.title: 打车前核对车辆
items.core: Confirm the license plate and driver before getting in the car.
body: 使用正规平台。
Share your itinerary with your fellow travelers.
After receiving the order, first check the license plate, model and driver’s name. If they are inconsistent, do not get in the car and cancel or contact the platform.
Stand in a place with lights and surveillance and wait for the bus, and do not solicit private or unlicensed cars on the roadside.
Share the itinerary with your family before getting in the car, write down the vehicle information and driver’s employee number, and pay attention to the route along the way.

Case: After working overtime at night, Xiao Chen saw a car with a license plate that was inconsistent with the software at the online ride-hailing pick-up point, so he did not get in the car. He contacted the driver again to confirm and got into a car with a matching license plate and got home safely.

items.title: 入住检查门窗
items.core: 安全比装饰重要。
body: Confirm that the lock is normal.
不让陌生人进门。
After entering, lock the door first and check the anti-theft chain, peephole and deadbolt. If there is any abnormality, please change rooms or contact the front desk immediately.
Check whether windows, balcony doors and connecting room doors are locked securely, and do not leave curtains open overnight on low floors.
Remember the nearest safety exit and front desk phone number, and confirm through the peephole first if you hear any strange noises outside the door at night.

Case: After checking into the B&B, Xiao Zhao first checked the door locks and windows and found that the balcony latch was loose. He immediately took photos and contacted the landlord to change rooms. He put his luggage inside that night and rested peacefully.

items.title: Be careful when riding in the elevator
items.core: Be careful when riding alone in the elevator at night.
body: Stand near the button.
感觉不对立即离开。
Try to ride with other passengers when taking the elevator at night. If someone stares or presses the floor repeatedly, you would rather wait for the next one.
Enter the elevator station and approach the buttons and door openings. If there is an abnormality, you can press the door opening or alarm in time.
Before exiting the elevator, check the corridor to see if anyone is wandering. If you feel something is wrong, return to the elevator immediately and contact the staff.

Case: At 11 o'clock at night, when Xiao Liu returned to the hotel, she saw a strange man following him into the elevator. She quit and waited for the next one, and asked the front desk to accompany her upstairs to avoid the uneasiness of riding alone in the elevator.

items.title: Recognizing Street Scams
items.core: Over-enthusiasm often has a purpose.
body: Do not accept initiative to lead the way.
Confirm the price yourself.

When you encounter someone who takes the initiative to strike up a conversation, recognize someone from your hometown, buy tickets on your behalf, or lend money, keep your distance first and don’t be embarrassed to say no.
Always stop when transfers, deposits, and security deposits are involved, and verify the information through the official window or platform.
Do not give your mobile phone, documents, or luggage to strangers. If necessary, call the police or staff.

Case: At the exit of the train station, a man enthusiastically helped Xiao Sun move boxes, and then said that the fellow villager urgently needed to borrow money to buy a train ticket. Xiao Sun didn't pay, he just asked him to find a staff member and left directly.

items.title: Accept help with caution
items.core: The kindness of strangers may come at a cost.
body: Priority is given to finding staff.
No food or drinks will be accepted.
When strangers offer to lead the way, do things for you, stand in line and charge fees, please refuse first and ask at the official window.
It’s okay to accept directions, but don’t follow strangers to remote places, and don’t hand over your phone and wallet.
If the other party keeps pestering you, go to a crowded place and contact the staff or call the police instead of arguing alone.

Case: At the entrance of the hospital, an aunt took the initiative to say that if she knew the doctor, she could avoid queuing. She also asked Xiao Zhou to pay the registration fee of 200 yuan first. After Xiao Zhou declined, he went to the self-service machine to register and found that the normal process was not complicated.

items.title: Eat gradually
items.core: The stomach needs time to adapt.
body: Eat familiar foods first.
Cold and cautious.
When traveling to a new place, try a small amount of local spicy, cold or greasy food to allow your stomach and intestines a long time to adapt.
Carry commonly used gastrointestinal medicines with you, but do not take them on an empty stomach just for prevention.
Observe for abdominal distension and diarrhea after eating. If you feel unwell, stop eating new foods and replenish fluids to rest.

Case: On the first day in Chengdu, Xiao He ordered a small portion of slightly spicy hot pot. He only tasted a few slices of tripe and vegetables, and did not drink iced drinks right away. He had no gastrointestinal discomfort at night, and then gradually increased the spiciness.

items.title: Make sure the water is safe
items.core: Buy bottled water when in doubt.
body: Also use safe water when brushing your teeth.
Prepare gastrointestinal medicine.
When you are unsure about the water quality, do not drink raw water, brush your teeth, or wash fruits with raw water. Give priority to bottled water.
Check the seal and production date of bottled water, drink it as soon as possible after opening, and do not touch the bottle lip with the rim.
The water must be boiled completely before drinking. Kettles and cups should be rinsed carefully with potable water first.

Case: In a mountain guesthouse, Xiao Lin saw that the tap water turned yellow, so he did not brush his teeth directly. Instead, he bought bottled water for drinking and brushing his teeth. Someone in the same group drank raw water and had diarrhea at night, but Xiao Lin was not affected.

items.title: Avoid off-the-beaten-path routes at night
items.core: Lighting and foot traffic are safety indicators.
body: Take a taxi back to your residence.
Check the route in advance.
At night, give priority to roads with good lighting, many shops, and a steady flow of people. Even if you walk ten minutes longer, it is worth it.
Speed ​​up your pace when passing overpasses, underpasses and construction sections, and don’t wear noise-cancelling headphones to distract you.
If you feel you are being followed, immediately enter a convenience store or hotel lobby and contact your companions or call a taxi.

Case: At nine o'clock in the evening, Xiao Tang returned to his residence from the subway station. The navigation suggested that walking through an alley would save ten minutes, but he chose the main road with street lights and convenience stores. There were many people on the road, and he returned to the hotel smoothly.

items.title: Agreed meeting point
items.core: No need to look around if you get separated.
body: Choose a conspicuous and fixed location.
Write it down for your children and peers.
Before departure, specify the meeting point to the store name, house number or sign. Be sure not to just say "see you at the door."
Agree on multiple time points, such as 11 a.m. and 4 p.m. If you miss it, just wait for half an hour.
Write the name and phone number of your traveler on a small piece of paper and put it in your bag to prevent the phone from running out of battery and being unable to contact you.

Case: There were many people at the entrance of the scenic spot. Xiao Yang and his friends agreed that if they got separated, they would wait under the big screen in the visitor center. Later, the phone battery ran out, so Xiao Yang went over as agreed and met up with his friends within ten minutes.

items.title: Division of labor among companions
items.core: Some people are responsible for looking after the luggage, while others are responsible for asking for directions.
body: Speak clearly before departure.
Keep your contact information open.
Before traveling, make it clear who will check the luggage, buy the tickets, and ask for directions to avoid gaps caused by multiple people leaving at the same time.
When documents, tickets and money are involved, one person will keep them, and backup photos will be taken and stored in the mobile phone.
Check each other’s number of people and items at each node, and deal with them at the meeting point if they get separated.

Case: When transferring at a busy station, Xiao Wu was responsible for looking at the luggage and tickets, while his companion asked about the location of the platform and the bathroom; the two acted according to the division of labor, without repeated troubles, and caught up with the transfer train.

items.title: Pay attention to food hygiene
items.core: Gastrointestinal discomfort will most affect the itinerary.
body: Choose restaurants with regular crowds.
Be careful with raw and cold food.
Observe the flow of people and table turnover rate in restaurants, and give priority to stores with refrigerated ingredients and bright kitchens to reduce the risk of gastrointestinal infections.
Be careful with raw pickled, cold and unpeeled fruits. Tourists with sensitive stomachs are advised to wash them with boiled or bottled water first.
Carry oral rehydration salts with you to replenish electrolytes in time for mild diarrhea to avoid dehydration affecting subsequent itinerary arrangements.

Case: When I was eating grilled seafood at the night market, I saw that the stalls mixed cooked and raw seafood, so I bought freshly steamed and hot food and added less cold salad. The next day, my companions who ate raw and pickled seafood had abdominal pain, but I boarded the early boat as planned.

items.title: Confirm whether the water is drinkable
items.core: Buy bottled water when in doubt.
body: Understand local customs.
Prepare gastrointestinal medicine.
Check whether the faucet is marked with the Potable or cork logo, and ask the hotel front desk about the tap water treatment standards before making a decision.
Bottled water is often not available in hotel rooms at night. You can boil it in an electric kettle for 1 minute, then cool it and put it into a clean water cup for drinking.
Be wary of the source of ice. If the water used to make ice is unknown, ask for no ice when ordering to avoid invisible raw water intake.

Case: When staying at a B&B in Shancheng, the landlord said that the water from the faucet was drinkable, but I still boiled it with an electric kettle and bought bottled water. My roommate had diarrhea in the middle of the night, so I went hiking as usual the next day.

items.title: Make a note of the local emergency number
items.core: Emergency numbers are not the same in many countries.
body: Save to mobile phone and paper.
Write down the contact information of the embassy or consulate.
In addition to the local emergency number, the consular protection phone number of the Chinese embassy and consulate in the country is also stored simultaneously, which is the final legal backing.
Save the number into the quick dial of your mobile phone and write it on a piece of waterproof paper to keep in your wallet to prevent the phone from running out of battery or being broken and lost.
Mark the real location of the nearest tertiary hospital or international clinic offline in the map app instead of just saving the phone number.

Case: When I fell while riding a bicycle in Chiang Mai, Thailand, my friend first found the local emergency number 1669 and saved it in his mobile phone. He also wrote it on the back of the luggage tag. Later, he called a passerby at the scene to call for help, and the ambulance arrived in more than 20 minutes.

items.title: Check the terms of travel insurance
items.core: Exclusions are more critical than the amount insured.
body: Confirm medical and baggage terms.
Keep the insurance contract.
Check the exemption clauses one by one, paying special attention to extreme sports, pre-existing conditions and drunkenness, which are often listed as exclusions.
Confirm whether advance payment of medical expenses is required. If advance payment is required, check whether the deductible and reimbursement ratio are within the acceptable range.
Save the screenshot of the policy number and 24-hour rescue phone number in the photo album of your mobile phone, and send a copy to the domestic emergency contact for backup.

Case: Before taking out the insurance, I read the terms one by one and found that skiing and plateau hiking were listed in the exclusions. After choosing a plan that included mountain rescue, when I called for rescue for a sprain while hiking in Switzerland, the cost of more than 2,000 Swiss francs was successfully reimbursed.

items.title: Prepare two payment methods
items.core: If a single channel fails, it will be very passive.
body: Bring a small amount of cash and a backup card.
Inform the bank of your travel plans.
Prepare a credit card with Visa or Mastercard logo to ensure smooth overseas large-amount consumption and hotel pre-authorization.
Carry a small amount of cash in local currency with you for tips, street vendors, or for urgent transactions in the event of a sudden power outage.
Open Alipay or WeChat overseas services, or bind a UnionPay card as a backup to cope with business districts where mobile payment is popular.

Case: After dinner in a European town, mobile payment could not be opened due to overseas traffic failure. I took out my spare Visa card to pay the bill; my friend who was traveling with me only had one code to pay, so I had to stay in the restaurant and wait for the network to recover.

items.title: Prevent acclimatization in advance
items.core: Dietary changes require adaptation.
body: Prepare commonly used gastrointestinal medicines.
Avoid overeating on the first day.
The diet for the first two days upon arrival will mainly be light cooked food, and gradually introduce local spicy or raw and cold food to provide a transition period for the gastrointestinal tract.
Carry the probiotics or digestive enzymes you usually take with you to help maintain the stability of intestinal flora and cope with changes in dietary structure.
Prepare a few packs of tea or granules brought from home and drink them when you feel unwell, which can provide psychological comfort and replenish water.

Case: It was my first time traveling to Chaoshan. I didn’t try raw or cold seafood immediately. I ate light porridge noodles and bottled water for two consecutive meals, and then gradually added local dishes. After three days, my appetite stabilized, and I participated in the night tour of Chaozhou Ancient City as normal.

items.title: Pay attention to sun protection
items.core: Time spent outdoors is easily underestimated.
body: Use sunscreen.
避开正午暴晒。
When applying sunscreen, don’t miss behind the ears, the tops of the feet and the hairline. These are the blind spots most susceptible to sunburn outdoors.
Reapply every two hours after sweating or getting in the water. Choose products with SPF30 or above and are waterproof to protect against strong tropical UV rays.
Bring a parasol or wear long-sleeved sun protection clothing. Physical shielding is more effective and longer-lasting than simply applying sunscreen.

Case: When riding around Qinghai Lake, I applied SPF50 sunscreen and wore sunglasses on a cloudy morning. The wind was strong and the sun was strong at the intersection at noon, and the people in the same team who only wore hats got sunburned cheeks, but I was able to continue on my way in the evening.

items.title: Prevention from mosquito bites
items.core: Especially important in tropical areas.
body: 使用驱蚊用品。
穿长袖长裤。
Look for mosquito repellents containing DEET (DEET) or picaridin, which are effective against tropical insecticide-resistant mosquitoes.
Check whether there are holes in the screen windows when staying, and use mosquito nets or electric mosquito coils when sleeping to build a physical and chemical double line of defense.
Wear light-colored long-sleeved clothes. Mosquitoes are more likely to bite dark-colored clothes. This also reduces the exposed skin area and reduces the risk.

Case: Before going shopping at the night market in the ancient city of Chiang Mai, I wore light-colored trousers and sprayed mosquito repellent containing DEET on my cuffs. My friend wearing shorts next to me got more than a dozen mosquito bites, but I only got one bite all night.

items.title: Be prepared in advance for motion sickness and seasickness
items.core: Taking medication in advance is more effective than after the attack.
body: Learn about the side effects of medications.
选择靠前座位。
Motion sickness medicines such as dimenhydrinate should be taken 30-60 minutes before taking a ride. They take effect in advance and are much more effective than remedial action after the onset.
Try ginger slices or special motion sickness patches, which contain no drowsiness ingredients and are suitable for short drives or trips where you need to stay awake.
Try to choose a front-row seat, keep your eyes on the distant horizon while driving, and avoid reading or staring at your mobile phone in the shaking car.

Case: Half an hour before taking the ferry to the island, I took seasickness medicine as instructed and chose a window seat in the middle. Someone on the same boat was temporarily unwell and vomited twice. I was only slightly sleepy during the whole journey and went directly to snorkeling after getting off the boat.

items.title: Carry a Band-Aid with you
items.core: The sooner minor wounds are treated, the better.
body: 保持伤口清洁。
异常时就医。
Prepare band-aids of different sizes, especially special ones for joints. Ordinary tapes can easily fall off when your fingers are worn.
With individually packaged iodophor cotton swabs, first clean the wound with disinfectant in a circular motion from the inside out, and then apply a dressing after it is completely dry.
If the blisters have broken or the wound is deep, use sterile gauze and bandage to wrap it. Band-Aids are only suitable for small superficial wounds.

Case: When renting a bicycle at Xi'an City Wall, a small piece of leather was worn out on the heel of my shoe. I immediately put on a waterproof band-aid and changed my socks; my friend who was traveling with me did not take care of it and developed blisters the next day, which cost me half the distance I walked.

items.title: Bring anti-allergy medicine
items.core: Food and environment can trigger it.
body: 了解自己的过敏史。
严重时立即求助。
Carry an over-the-counter antihistamine, such as loratadine, for quick relief from mild to moderate allergies caused by food or pollen.
If you have difficulty breathing or swelling of your throat, this is a sign of a severe allergic reaction. You must seek medical attention immediately while taking the medicine.
If you eat at an unfamiliar restaurant, you can take photos of the food so that doctors can quickly determine the possible allergens if an allergy occurs.

Case: After eating shrimp at a seaside B&B, I developed a red rash on my arm. I first took anti-allergic medicine and stopped eating seafood. The symptoms subsided during the night, and I was able to go to sea as planned the next day without seeking a temporary hospital.

items.title: Make a note of the local emergency number
items.core: 不同国家号码不同。
body: 保存在手机和纸上。
Includes embassy and consulate phone numbers.
Use the "share location" function of tools such as Google Maps to generate precise location links and send them directly to the police when calling the police.
Save short phrases in local languages ​​such as "I need an ambulance" in the memo on your mobile phone in advance to make it easier to ask for help from operators who don't speak English.
Confirm the actual location of the nearest police station or tourist police box. Some countries require you to contact the police first instead of calling an ambulance directly.

Case: I went on a free trip to Osaka, Japan. On the day I checked in, I copied the police phone number 110, the emergency phone number 119 and the hotel front desk phone number on a note. After my mother got separated in the mall, she showed the note to the security guard. We met at the service desk half an hour later.

items.title: Learn about nearby medical points
items.core: Check the location when you arrive.
body: Record the address and password.
确认营业时间。
Save the emergency entrance within a ten-minute walk from your accommodation on the map and mark whether it is open at night.
Take a screenshot of the hotel front desk phone number and the address of the nearest pharmacy. You can show it directly to the driver even when the Internet is disconnected.
Confirm whether an appointment is required, whether cash is supported, and the time it takes to take a taxi from your residence to the gate.

Case: On the first day after Ms. Wang arrived in Kyoto, she collected clinics with night services near the B&B on the map of her mobile phone. On the third day, she suddenly suffered from stomach pain. She followed the favorite navigation and walked for five minutes to see a doctor. After getting the prescription, she took the medicine and rested smoothly without delaying her schedule for the next day.

items.title: Confirm Insurance Coverage
items.core: Exclusions are more critical than the amount insured.
body: Understand the reimbursement process.
Keep all documents.
Read the disclaimer word for word to confirm whether rock climbing, diving, drunk driving, etc. are excluded.
Check whether there are separate limits for outpatient, inpatient, emergency and transfer services. Don’t just look at the total number.
Save the policy page and reporting phone number offline, and note down the specific values ​​of the waiting period and deductible.

Case: When Mr. Chen bought overseas travel insurance, he only valued the high medical coverage and did not read clearly the terms that listed diving as an exclusion. After snorkeling in Phuket, he went to see a doctor for ear discomfort. The cost of more than 2,000 US dollars was all paid out of pocket. Only then did he regret not checking the exemption scope in advance.

items.title: Keep medical records
items.core: Required for both claim settlement and follow-up treatment.
body: Save diagnostics and tickets.
Record medication.
Take pictures of medical records, prescriptions, and examination orders on the same day after each consultation to make sure the name and date are clear.
If the doctor only gives you an electronic bill, download the original and export the invoice details. Don’t just leave a screenshot of the payment.
Create a folder by date and mark the drug name, dosage and allergy history for easy explanation when changing doctors.

Case: Ms. Lin was scratched by a motorcycle in Chiang Mai. She took photos of the wound, left a medical certificate and a payment receipt. When she returned to China to apply for a claim, the insurance company completed the review and payment within three days based on these records, and she did not need to provide any overseas certification materials.

items.title: Confirmation is required when using medical insurance in other places
items.core: Different systems have different rules.
body: Learn if direct settlement is possible.
Keep the original ticket.
Before departure, register for off-site medical treatment on the national medical insurance platform, and check the validity period and registration area.
Ask whether the local hospital will settle the bill directly and what original receipts should be kept if settlement cannot be made.
Confirm outpatient and inpatient reimbursement ratios, deductibles, and whether referral certificates are required.

Case: Before Aunt Zhao went to Hainan for the winter, she registered for medical treatment in another place on the medical insurance APP, and then confirmed the direct settlement at the hospital window. When she went for a follow-up consultation for high blood pressure and took medicine, she swiped her medical insurance card to directly deduct the money. She didn't advance the full payment and didn't take the receipt back to the place where she was insured to run errands.

items.title: See a doctor if symptoms persist
items.core: Do not delay your discomfort until your return trip.
body: Record symptoms and time.
Seek local medical help.
If you have fever for more than three days, chest pain, shortness of breath, or abnormal consciousness, go to the emergency room immediately without observation.
Diarrhea accompanied by dehydration, a rash that spreads rapidly, or a wound that is red, swollen and pus-producing can also be considered a sign that medical attention is needed.
Record body temperature, onset time and aggravating factors so that doctors can more quickly determine the risk during consultation.

Case: Xiao Zhou’s knees continued to be sore after hiking in Lijiang. He did not carry it until the return trip. He went to the hospital near the inn to take a X-ray that day, and it was found that he had a mild meniscus injury. After braking in time, he adjusted his subsequent stroke to prevent the injury from worsening and affecting his work.

items.title: Bring sufficient quantities of chronic disease medications
items.core: It may be difficult to make temporary prescriptions.
body: Bring enough for a few days.
Bring the prescription and name of the medicine.
Prepare an extra seven days of commonly used medicine according to the number of days of the trip, and keep the original packaging and English common names.
Put necessary medicines in your carry-on bag and keep at least a day's supply on hand. You will also have medicines available when changing flights.
Bring a copy of your doctor’s prescription, indicating the dosage and indications, for easy verification at the airport or local purchase of medicines.

Case: Mr. Liu suffers from diabetes. Before going on a business trip to Tokyo, he calculated the number of days of the trip and brought an extra seven days' worth of medicine. On the day of arrival, it was a weekend, and prescription medicines at nearby pharmacies required an appointment. He relied on bringing his own medicines to get through it smoothly, and there was no blood sugar fluctuation caused by discontinuation of medicines.

items.title: Respect local customs
items.core: Knowing in advance can avoid offending.
body: Be aware of clothing and physical boundaries.
Ask permission before taking photos.
Read the door signs before entering a religious place to confirm whether you are covering your shoulders and knees, taking off your shoes, or taking photos is prohibited.
When queuing, greetings and shaking hands are customary, first check with the locals and nod when unsure.
Avoid arguing loudly or urging service staff in public places. Lower your volume when encountering disagreements.

Case: Xiao Chen visited a Thai temple and checked the rules in advance that he needed to take off his shoes and not point at the monks. She wore shoes that were easy to put on and take off, and took care to avoid people who were worshiping Buddha when taking photos. She did not attract any attention or warning from the locals through her unintentional behavior during the whole process.

items.title: Prepare key sentences in language
items.core: Knowing a few sentences is enough to solve most problems.
body: Remember the words for help, price and directions.
Write the address in local script.
Translate hotel addresses, food allergies and common symptoms into local text and save them offline.
Learn the four types of sentences to ask about the price, whether the card can be swiped, the location of the toilet and whether a reservation is needed.
When using translation software, first say a short sentence and show the screen to the other party to confirm the key figures before closing the deal.

Case: Mr. Wu went to Paris for the first time. Before departure, he saved the hotel address, food allergies and the French phrase "I need help" on his mobile phone. When asking for directions, he directly showed his address to passers-by. He quickly understood the two simple French sentences and successfully found the subway station.

items.title: Keep the shopping voucher
items.core: Required for tax refund and after-sales service.
body: Take a photo to keep the receipt.
Check the tax refund threshold.
Immediately after payment, check the store name, date, product specifications and tax refund qualification mark on the receipt.
If the tax refund document requires customs stamping, please allow time before leaving the country and take photos to retain the filled-in contents.
Archive electronic invoices by merchant classification, and attach order numbers and photos of failures during after-sales service to make it faster.

Case: Ms. Sun bought a defective woolen sweater in Sydney, and she kept the cashier receipt. After returning to China, I found that the line was open. I contacted the store with a photo of the receipt and order record, and the other party directly agreed to send a new one, saving me the trouble of cross-border returns and exchanges.

items.title: Check for omissions before returning
items.core: Documents, chargers and medicines are most likely to be left behind.
body: Check each item on the list.
Confirm the transportation time in advance.
Check the list of passports, bank cards, keys and access cards, and tick each item when you see it in person.
Check all device plugs, data cables and adapters, and confirm that they can be charged normally before packing.
Check the bedside, bathroom, and refrigerator for leftover pill boxes, wipes, glasses, and receipts.

Case: Mr. Zheng returned from Dali. Before checking out of the hotel, he checked the bedside, sockets and bathroom according to the list and found that he had forgotten the charger and antihypertensive medicine. He retrieved both items on the spot, avoiding the hassle and extra expense of sending them back home.

items.title: Organize the records after coming back
items.core: Turn the experience into an experience for next time.
body: Write down the pitfalls you have stepped on and the useful places.
Organize photos and expenses.
Name the tickets, photos and routes by date on the day you return home, and back them up to two locations first.
Write down three types of problems: those that exceed the budget, those that are too tight, and those that will be repeated next time to save worry.
Record the actual cost and waiting time to leave a more accurate margin for the next booking, transportation and meals.

Case: Every time Ms. He comes back from a trip, she will record the usage of hotels, restaurants and transportation APPs in notes. The next time she plans her trip to Iceland, she directly pulls out the contact information of the reliable guide she recorded last time, saving the time of re-screening and comparison.

items.title: Respect local customs
items.core: Knowing in advance can avoid offending.
body: Be aware of the dress code.
了解禁忌话题。
Before eating, confirm whether alcohol is prohibited, whether meals should be shared, and what actions represent rejection or thanks.
Ask for permission before taking portraits. When encountering religious ceremonies or children, it is better not to take pictures than to get close.
Check the amount and occasion before giving gifts or tipping to avoid making the thank you embarrassing or causing misunderstandings.

Case: Before Xiao Zheng traveled to a Middle Eastern country, he learned that local shops would be closed during worship hours on Fridays. He arranged his main visits for Thursday and Saturday, and prepared a long-sleeved scarf in his bag. When entering the mosque, he covered his shoulders and neck as required and was not blocked from the door.

items.title: Learn a few local phrases
items.core: Basic communication is enough to solve the problem.
body: Remember the help and price.
Write the address in local script.

Write down in advance the key words for the three scenarios of asking for directions, ordering food, and asking for help, such as toilet, how much, please help, and save them in memo on your mobile phone for reference at any time.

Go to a convenience store or stall and try saying thank you and goodbye in the local language. After the other person responds, add a simple question to practice your courage and confirm your pronunciation.

When you don’t understand something, hand the other party the translation interface on your mobile phone to read the text. It is more convenient than speaking English over and over again, and it also reduces misunderstandings between the two parties.

Case: After arriving at an unfamiliar airport, I asked for directions and confirmed the ticket window in the local language I had written down in advance. Although I only knew three sentences, it solved the problem of transferring and finding the boarding gate.

items.title: Ask permission before taking photos
items.core: Especially when it comes to people and religious places.
body: Ask or observe the sign first.
不强行拍摄。

Hold your phone and point at the other person first and then at the camera, follow the questioning gesture, wait for a nod or wave your hand before pressing the shutter button, don’t take photos secretly while walking.
In the temple, look at the sign at the door. If photography is prohibited in areas, put away your device directly. Don’t hesitate to hold up your phone to avoid being reminded by the staff.

After the other party agrees, take the photo, say thank you, and then leave. If you send the photo to them, the other party will take the initiative to copy it before sending it to you. Do not directly send it to your social media account.

Case: When visiting a temple in Chiang Mai, a tourist saw a monk chanting sutras and wanted to take a close-up photo. He first used hand gestures to ask and waited for the other person to nod. He only took a photo of his back in the distance to avoid conflict and retain a souvenir.

items.title: Keep the shopping voucher
items.core: Required for tax refund and after-sales service.
body: Take a photo to keep the receipt.
Check the tax refund threshold.

Proactively ask for paper receipts and tax refund forms when checking out, even if you don’t apply for a tax refund that day. Many countries require original documents to be stamped before leaving the country.

Put the receipts into the compartment of the passport holder according to the store classification. Do not mix them with change. Do not press the crease of the tax refund form onto the barcode, otherwise the machine cannot read it.

Use your mobile phone to take a picture of each receipt and save it in a photo album for backup. Put the paper receipts in the inner layer of your suitcase. Separate the two places. If you lose one place, you can use the photo to negotiate.

Case: After buying a rice cooker at a Tokyo electrical appliance store, the clerk put the receipt and warranty card into a shopping bag. The customer took a photo to keep it and put away the original bag; after returning home, he found a voltage adaptation problem and successfully exchanged the product with the receipt.

items.title: Understand the tax refund process
items.core: Not all stores can offer tax refunds.
body: 确认最低金额。
留出办理时间。

When entering the store, first check to see if there is a tax refund sign sticker at the cashier. If not, just ask the clerk if you can do it. Don’t assume that all counters can issue tax refund forms.

Confirm whether a single purchase reaches the local minimum tax refund amount. Just make up the difference by a few euros before settling the bill. Otherwise, it will take more time to fill out the form in vain.

Go to the customs for stamping at the airport before checking in the tax refund items. Put the tax refund items in your carry-on bag for future reference. If you are in a hurry, go to the self-service machine first and leave room for queueing.

Case: When shopping in Paris, tourists only shop at pharmacies and department stores with tax refund signs, and use their mobile phones to record the airport stamping steps in advance, and follow the procedures when leaving the country to avoid discovering at the counter that tax refunds are not available in small stores.

items.title: Check items before returning
items.core: Documents, chargers, and medicines are the easiest to leave behind.
body: Check each item on the list.
Confirm the transportation time in advance.
Put your passport, wallet, and room card in a fixed place on the table the night before. Check off the list one by one before going out. Don't rely on memory in the morning.

Check the bedside sockets and bathroom countertops. Chargers are often plugged into the corner and forgotten to be unplugged. Medicine boxes are also easily left under the pillow. Turn on the light and scan them before leaving.

Put the documents and medicines you need for the next day into your carry-on bag first, and don’t wait to rummage through the suitcases when you check out to avoid delaying your train trip by looking for things at short notice.

Case: Before leaving the B&B, the passenger checked the bedside, sockets and bathroom according to the list. He found that his passport was under the pillow and the charger was still plugged in. He retrieved it in time and rushed to the airport with peace of mind.

items.title: 票据集中整理
items.core: 报销和记账都要用。
body: 按日期分类。
拍照备份。

Prepare a separate note folder with compartments, separate them according to transportation, dining, and shopping. Post the date when you get back to the hotel, and don’t pile them up before the return trip.

Spend two minutes every night to flatten out the day's receipts and insert them into a book. The finance department may not accept wrinkled expense reports. It is easier to flatten them and put them away than to make up for them afterwards.

After taking the photos and archiving them, bind the paper tickets according to categories, mark the corresponding dates and uses, and pull them out directly when reimbursing, without having to identify them one by one.

Case: On the night of returning from a business trip, he put the taxi tickets, meal expenses and hotel invoices into the document bag according to the date and marked the project name; when he submitted the reimbursement the next day, he passed it once and did not go through the luggage again to find the bill.

items.title: Timely backup of photos
items.core: The memory should not be lost if the device is lost.
body: 每晚备份一次。
Keep the original file.

Every night after returning to the hotel, connect the charging cable and open the photo album to automatically back up. Select a wireless network environment to upload. Don’t wait to catch up at the airport on the last day to upload.

After uploading in the cloud, copy a copy to a mobile hard drive or computer. It will be stable if you save it in both places. If your phone is lost, at least you can still find the complete original image.
Create a separate photo album and save the most satisfying photos of the day. If the backup fails, keep these first, and the other duplicate photos can be added later.

Case: On the third day of the trip, his phone broke on the subway. A friend who was traveling with him used a mobile hard drive to help him import the photos from the previous two days and uploaded them to the cloud disk. Although the screen went black, not a single photo of the trip was lost.

items.title: Record actual expenses
items.core: Budgets are only meaningful if compared.
body: 按类别记录。
回来后复盘。

Use accounting software to record items in four categories: transportation, accommodation, meals, and tickets. After each transaction is spent, immediately enter the amount. If you make up the amount at night, you may easily miss a small sum.
Record cash payments separately, and when you come back to reconcile, go through the day's itinerary. It is easier to find the difference than writing down the total.
Look at the total cost and the pre-departure budget side by side on the night of return. Mark the categories of overspending. Use this standard next time you book a room or eat.

Case: The original daily budget was 500 yuan. The tourist used accounting software to enter transportation, meals and tickets at night. He found that he overspent 300 yuan on food and beverages for three days. On the fourth day, he changed to a simple meal and brought the expenses back to the budget.

items.title: Write down the pitfalls you have stepped on
items.core: Experiences must be recorded before they can be reused.
body: 记下问题和解法。
整理成下次清单。
The moment I hit a trap, I used a memo on my phone to write a few sentences, stating the time, place and what happened. If I write it down a few days later, the details will become blurry.

Write down the reasons for being overcharged, taking the wrong way, and queuing in the wrong queue separately. Don’t just write down your emotions. Write down how you made the wrong judgment at the time to have reference value.

After returning, sort the scattered records into three categories: transportation, accommodation, and meals. In each category, select the item that you want to remind yourself the most and mark it in red. You can just glance at it next time.

Case: After the trip, he wrote down three things in the memo: he mistakenly took the bus in the opposite direction, the attraction was closed on Monday, and he ran out of cash. The next time he takes his family to the same city, the route and payment will be arranged more smoothly.

items.title: Adjust work and rest after return
items.core: Jet lag and fatigue need to be recovered.
body: 先补睡眠。
逐步恢复正常节奏。

Adjust your bedtime according to the number of time zones you span. If you fly east, go to bed an hour earlier. It will be easier to fall asleep for two consecutive days than staying up at the original time.

Go out and bask in the sun during the day to help your body calibrate your body's biological clock. Don't take a long nap in the evening. Even if you are sleepy, just lie down for twenty minutes before falling asleep deeply at night.
Do not arrange high-intensity work or exercise in the first two days of your return. Drink more water and less coffee to allow your body to slow down before returning to its normal rhythm.

Case: On the second day after flying back from Europe, he did not stay up late to catch up on the drama immediately. Instead, he ate at the local time, took a short nap for half an hour in the afternoon, and went to bed at 11 p.m. After three days, he basically recovered.

items.title: Organize the items brought back
items.core: Replace them in time to avoid accumulation.
body: 清点纪念品。
处理剩余药品。

On the day you get home, spread out your suitcases, put the clothes directly into the laundry basket, and put the toiletry bag back in the bathroom. Don't let the boxes pile up in the corner overnight.
Divide the things you buy into three piles: giving away, personal use, and filing. Write a card on the day you give it away. Don’t wait to send it later, or you will forget who gave what.

Put food and medicines out separately to check the shelf life. Label items that are about to expire and put them on the refrigerator door. Don’t mix them into your daily stockings and end up wasting them.

Case: After returning home, she first distributed the souvenirs to her family, then washed the clothes and hung them back in the closet, and put the souvenirs into the storage box. The suitcase was cleared that day, and she went to work the next day without being interrupted by debris.

items.title: Leave improvements for next time
items.core: Optimize the process on every trip.
body: 写下最该改的一件事。
更新打包清单。

Write a review list within a week of your return, and only remember the three things you most want to change, such as bringing one less coat and booking a car in advance. If you are too greedy, you will not remember it next time.

Write down the improvement items on a sticker on the inside of your suitcase or on the homepage of your mobile memo, and scan them before packing next time. This is more reliable than preparing based on impressions.

Check the items one by one against the records of the last pitfalls, cross out the ones that have been done well and keep the ones that have not been done, and change to a more specific method if it has not been changed twice in a row.

Case: After returning from a trip, I found that the power bank was forgotten in the hotel and the taxi fare exceeded the budget. I wrote "check electrical appliances before packing" and "reserve taxi allowance" in the notes on the return trip, which will obviously make things smoother next time.
